querySettings.query:
SELECT
    trunc(a.date_entered)                                                                                 AS "DATE",
    a.order_no,
    a.customer_no,
    ifsapp.customer_info_api.get_name(a.customer_no)                                                            
    AS name_ ,
    ifsapp.sales_region_api.get_description(ifsapp.cust_ord_customer_address_api.get_region_code(cus.customer_id, '1'))
    AS region ,
    a.line_total_weight                                                                                   AS weight_,
    decode(a.cf$_item_type, 'PNEUMATIC', 'ST3','SOLID','ST1')                                                           AS cf$_item_type,
    a.catalog_no,
    a.state,
    cus.country ,
    ifsapp.customer_order_line_api.get_base_sale_price_total(a.order_no, a.line_no, a.rel_no, a.line_item_no)   
    AS usd_val 
FROM
    ifsapp.customer_order_line_cfv a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN ifsinfo.dwc_active_prices      b ON a.customer_no = b.customer_no
                                                   AND a.catalog_no = b.catalog_no,
    ifsapp.customer_info_cfv              cus
WHERE
        cus.customer_id = a.customer_no
    AND a.company = 'GRISL'
   AND a.contract = 'GRI01'
    AND a.cf$_item_type = 'PNEUMATIC'
    AND a.catalog_type_db <> 'PKG'
    AND a.part_no LIKE 'P%'
    AND a.state <> 'Cancelled'
    AND a.customer_no <> 'CS0286'
